scope: The standing airport museum at 2088 Wellington Avenue, opened 2022, including the tapered metal hangar envelope, elevated northwest glass corner, covered street entry and airside return.
era: Current May 2022 museum building and its permanent exterior.

stories.title: Royal Aviation Museum of Western Canada

review.notes: The already-published Qualla photographs show aircraft, trainers or the previous museum interior. The new museum exterior had no independently cleared reference. Native mapped controls and the building owner, architect and contractor’s written facts establish the appearance.
